name: Slack – Send Message to Channel
description: Instantly send a message to a specific Slack channel to notify teams about a new alert, incident, or task update. Useful for real-time collaboration or escalation during active investigations.
trigger:
  next:
    - SlackV2ChatPostMessage
  name: On demand
  type: On demand
  parameters:
    $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema
    properties:
      json:
        properties:
          channel:
            type: string
            title: Channel
            description: 'Slack channel ID or name (for example, #security-alerts).'
          text:
            type: string

- **`request_url` is ABSOLUTE and region-specific** — e.g.
  `https://api.us-2.crowdstrike.com/alerts/queries/alerts/v2` (US-1 =
  `api.crowdstrike.com`, EU-1 = `api.eu-1.crowdstrike.com`). A relative path
  (`/alerts/...`) is rejected with "Invalid URL format".
- **No query string in the URL.** Query params go in the `request_query`
